title: T1594 — Search Victim-Owned Websites
subtitle: Watch an attacker map a victim website, harvest staff data, probe for hidden files, and find an exposed source folder, while the defender watches the same story in the logs.
aria: An attacker maps a victim website, harvests staff data, probes hidden directories, and finds an exposed source folder while the WAF and SOC watch the logs

steps.caption: archived copies

steps.caption: s, and email patterns
